title: The Marina One Penthouse
excerpt: Raymond Teo, 47, founder of Teo Holdings, was found unresponsive in the master bedroom of his Marina One penthouse at 04:22 by his housekeeper. No forced entry. No sign of struggle visible from the doorway. Cause of death pending pathology, but the responding officer flagged the scene as suspicious.

title: Seed access log summary
excerpt: Penthouse access log shows door opened from the inside at 02:51, three minutes after estimated TOD.

title: Seed forensic note
excerpt: Tumbler on the nightstand contains residue of a benzodiazepine not prescribed to the victim.

title: Marcus lobby statement
excerpt: Saw Priya leave the lobby at 03:12, much later than her usual departure. Logged a delivery van that was never on the manifest.
